grain: account x trading day x asset class

columns.name: firm
columns.meaning: the registry-derived firm scope this row belongs to; never a typed token

columns.name: account_id
columns.meaning: the custodian account id in the declaration's account form (10-char zero-padded), as account_return_daily carries it

columns.name: business_date
columns.meaning: the TRADING day (lib/trading_calendar.py), the same performance axis as account_return_daily

columns.name: asset_class
columns.meaning: one of class_enum; the class the held securities (and, for cash, the custodian's cash lines) map to

columns.name: market_value_eod
columns.meaning: MV_c,t -- the class's end-of-day market value; the classes of one account-day sum to account_return_daily.market_value_eod (to the cent, the sub-cent rounding residual sits in cash) on a MEASURED day

columns.name: class_return_daily
columns.meaning: the class's CONTRIBUTION to the account's daily total return (not the class's own return): (MV_c,t - MV_c,t-1 - NF_c,t) / V_(t-1). Null whenever coverage is not MEASURED

columns.name: method_version
columns.meaning: the class-split method this figure was produced under (1); distinct from account_return_daily.method_version

columns.name: coverage
columns.meaning: why class_return_daily is, or is not, served for this account-day; a member of enums.coverage

class_source.pin_meaning: the commit that gave the module its six-class values (MDPF_SECCLASS SC-e-21: fixed_income, equity, structured, alternatives, commodities, and no multi_asset); read at that pin or later through the dictionary ETF_CLASSIFICATIONS
class_source.supersedes: PRD ruling 13 (Q3): the portal's HoldingAssetClass type was the interim authority 'until MDPF_SECCLASS lands a class value list'; this contract cites the module at @63fa1a2e32 instead, by this addendum and not silently
class_source.read_as: the producer reads the module's DICTIONARY, never its helper get_asset_class(ticker, default='equity'), which returns 'equity' for a ticker it does not know (a guess)
rules: a holding is identified by its ticker_symbol, else its cusip, else '<no identifier>'
a cash identifier (CASH, CASH_USD) is `cash`, whatever the module says: the module files CASH_USD under fixed_income
an identifier the module names is that class; an identifier it does not name is `unclassified`, its own class and never folded into another
a module value outside the vocabulary REFUSES the run; it is neither mapped nor guessed
the custodian's cash lines (money_mkt_funds, net_credit_debit, margin_balance) are `cash`

method.formula: class_return_daily_c,t = (MV_c,t - MV_c,t-1 - NF_c,t) / D_t, with D_t = V_(t-1), the account_return_daily producer's own denominator

terms.V_t, V_(t-1), F_t: the account_return_daily producer's own whole-account values and external flow, imported read-only from that producer; not recomputed
terms.MV_c: the class's summed position market value (dim_position market_value_settled_unsettled); for cash, the position cash rows plus the custodian's cash lines
terms.NF_c (non-cash): net trade flow into the class on day t from fact_trn: buys minus sells at gross_amount over every custodian partition day the producer's skipped-day rule carries into t, plus the securities that crossed the account boundary in kind AND entered F_t, valued and admitted by the producer's own classify_and_sum
terms.NF_cash: F_t minus the sum of the other classes' NF, so the NF terms sum to F_t by construction

method.identity: sum over classes of class_return_daily = (V_t - V_(t-1) - F_t) / V_(t-1) = account_return_daily.total_return_daily, because sum(MV_c) = V on both days and sum(NF_c) = F_t. Measured on the local run to a largest gap of about 2e-16
method.adaptation: The producer's numerator is V_t - F_t - V_(t-1) over V_(t-1) (r_t = (V_t - F_t) / V_(t-1) - 1), which is exactly MV_t - MV_t-1 - external_flow_t on the whole account, so the class numerator needed no adaptation on a day the producer links in one step. A day the producer links through an intervening custodian valuation (its sub-period chain) has no such numerator and is not decomposed (coverage LINKED_VALUATION_CHAIN).
method.sum_check: On each of the two days the class values read from positions and the cash lines are compared to the producer's V; they must tie to within 0.005 (positions carry four decimals, the balance two). Where they do, cash is set to V less the non-cash classes so the sum is exact and the sub-cent residual sits in cash. Where they do not the day is not measurable for classes: class_return_daily is null with coverage CLASS_VALUES_DO_NOT_SUM_TO_ACCOUNT. No plug covers a real gap.
limits: INCOME LANDS IN CASH under method_version 1: a dividend or interest receipt is cash received, so it is the cash class's contribution; a reinvested dividend is a buy out of cash into the security, so the security's class shows the price move only and the receipt shows in cash. Per-class income is not split out.
Advisory fees, commissions and other expenses land in cash (cash is the plug class).
A corporate action carried by no trade or in-kind row (a split, a merger with no in-kind leg) shows as the class's own return, as the account producer treats it.
An in-kind leg the producer classifies INTERNAL is not in F_t and so is not a class flow: it shows as the class's return, consistent with account_return_daily.

A day the producer links through an intervening valuation (LINKED_VALUATION_CHAIN) and a day whose class values do not tie to the account (CLASS_VALUES_DO_NOT_SUM_TO_ACCOUNT) carry null, never an estimate.

Cash positions are the identifiers CASH and CASH_USD; a money-market fund held as a position is a security and takes the module's class, or `unclassified` where the module does not name it. It is not reassigned to cash.

The Schwab trade-leg tokens (tr_cd TR, trade_typcd BUY/SELL, ticker_symbol) are declared in the producer's TRADE_LEG_DECLARATION block because sources.json is outside this cell's grant (surprise row IRPT_DASHBD-W18-S1); the release cell moves them into the declaration.
Only the account_return_daily producer's measured accounts and days exist here: no row before an account's first positive value.

i_mece_over_a_declared_domain.asset_class: domain: 'which class a holding contributes to'. Six module classes plus cash and unclassified. Covered by subtraction: a holding is cash (a cash identifier or a custodian cash line), else the module names it (one of fixed_income, equity, structured, alternatives, commodities), else it is `unclassified`. The module's helper default 'equity' is NOT a member of the domain; the producer never calls it.
i_mece_over_a_declared_domain.coverage: domain: 'why this account-day's class return is, or is not, served'. Covered by subtraction: the account return is measurable or not (ACCOUNT_RETURN_NOT_MEASURABLE); the positions partitions exist or not (POSITIONS_PARTITION_ABSENT); the class values tie to V or not (CLASS_VALUES_DO_NOT_SUM_TO_ACCOUNT); the producer linked in one step or through a chain (LINKED_VALUATION_CHAIN); the trade legs read or not (TRADE_FLOW_UNREADABLE); otherwise MEASURED. Precedence is the list order, so each account-day carries exactly one member.

rule24_record.ii_same_grain: asset_class is a row property (account-day-class); coverage is an ACCOUNT-DAY property repeated on each class row of that account-day.
rule24_record.iii_intent_coherence: coverage answers ONE question, whether the class return is served and if not why. It does not say whether the account's own return is served (account_return_daily.day_quality) except through its member ACCOUNT_RETURN_NOT_MEASURABLE, which names that dependency.
rule24_record.iv_state_coherence: WHICH VALUES ONE REMEDY DOES NOT MOVE. Landing the classification module's missing tickers moves rows from `unclassified` into a named class and moves no coverage member. Repairing a position-to-balance gap at the custodian moves CLASS_VALUES_DO_NOT_SUM_TO_ACCOUNT only. A future decomposition of the linked chain moves LINKED_VALUATION_CHAIN only. None of them moves ACCOUNT_RETURN_NOT_MEASURABLE, which is the account producer's state.
rule24_record.token_census: NOT RUN in this cell: the word-boundary census of the two enums over the corpus is owed by the release cell before the contract is served.
